clues.text: He commanded the army of Jabin king of Canaan and lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
Told that Barak had gone up Mount Tabor, he called out nine hundred iron chariots to the River Kishon.
When the LORD routed his army before Barak, he abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.
Deborah told Barak that the LORD would sell this enemy commander into the hand of a woman.
Hiding in Jael's tent, he told her to answer 'No' if anyone asked whether a man was there.
His mother peered through the lattice, asking why his chariot was so long in coming.
In the song of Deborah and Barak, the stars fought against him from their courses.
